summary.motive: Overwhelm 5-man and 6-man pass protections with an unblockable 7-man zero-safety house blitz, forcing an immediate sub-2.0s throw or violent sack.
summary.keyDefender: LURKER (Unblocked interior house rusher) & LCB (Zero-safety press lock)
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses with 5 or 6 protectors mathematically cannot account for 7 rushers firing simultaneously into all 6 gaps, guaranteeing clean penetration.
summary.failureMode: Quick back-shoulder boundary fade or missed tackle in open space with zero safety help over the top.

beats.title: 7-Man Psycho Mug Pre-Snap Chaos
beats.text: Flores crowds the line of scrimmage with 7 defenders threatening every gap, creating maximum pre-snap confusion for the protection call.

beats.title: All 7 Rushers Fire Across All 6 Gaps
beats.text: At the snap, there is no bluff. All 7 rushers explode forward into every protection gap, creating a direct +1 numerical overload against the 6-man pass protection.

beats.title: Offensive Protection Overwhelmed
beats.text: With the offensive line locked in 1-on-1 matchups and the running back consumed, LURKER and LB_A2 shoot clean through the interior untouched.

beats.title: Instant 1.8s Sack & Hit on QB
beats.text: All receivers are suffocated in zero-safety press man coverage with zero hot answers open, resulting in a violent drive-killing sack before the QB can finish his drop.

relations.tell: All 7 defenders at the line of scrimmage rush full-tilt, leaving cornerbacks in pure zero-safety press man.
